    Hours of Operation

    2026 Summer Operating Schedule

    This hours page provides the most up-to-date operating schedules for Snow Valley, Snow Summit, and Bear Mountain Golf Course. We encourage you to read the Daily Message each day for important updates and an overview of current operations. Hours are subject to change at anytime.

    Chairlift hours can be found by viewing the calendars below. All other venues such as ticket windows, retail shops, rental and repair shop, locker rooms, restrooms, etc open up 30 minutes before and after chairlifts spin this summer. rich-text, responsive-table

    Summer Operations

    Snow Summit:Closed for summer operations as of Sunday, October 4.

    Snow Valley: Open select Fridays through Sundays through Sunday, October 25. Remaining operating dates include:

    October 9: 12PM-6PM
    October: 10-11: 9AM-4PM
    October 16: 12PM-6PM
    October 17-18: 9AM-4PM
    October 23: 12PM-6PM
    October 24-25: 9AM-4PM

    Bear Mountain Golf Course: Open daily through Sunday, October 25. Hours may adjust as daylight hours change.

    BBMR Visitor Center Station: The shop will continue to stay open daily year-round with eBike rentals pausing operations starting Sunday, October 25.

    rich-text, responsive-table

    Winter Operations

    While we’d love to give you an official opening date, the truth is, Mother Nature is the boss, and she hasn’t told us yet. We most likely won’t know until around mid-November, when temperatures begin to drop and we’re able to turn on our snowmaking systems. Once conditions are right, things can move quickly. That’s just how winter works here in Southern California: when the weather says go, we go! We’re also heading into an El Niño season, which could mean colder temperatures and, hopefully, plenty of snow.

    You can purchase winter products online today with a start date of November 21, 2026. Please keep in mind that November 21 is the earliest date the resorts may open for the 26/27 winter season, it is not a confirmed opening date. Sign up for the email newsletter to get updates straight to you inbox about opening day. rich-text, responsive-table
